next_step_summary: PR #199 records the product-owner decision to stop blocking development on GitHub Actions. validate-context remains non-required and GitHub workflow results are best-effort diagnostics only. Every implementation PR must instead complete focused local tests, assistant self-audit, and an actual Codex review before owner-approved merge. If Codex review cannot run because of account or usage limits, the PR is not considered reviewed until that review is completed. The next bounded implementation step is ocr-content-region-deskew-crop-v1; no Surya/provider call, Android upload, production encryption, PII handoff, Gemini call or permanent storage is authorized by this process decision.
